svg.text: How the landing page (/) is populated
my_polaris · order of events from request to rendered projects list
Runs first on every request to the app.
Reads the Clerk session cookie so auth() works on the server. Blocks nothing.
Auth is still "loading" here → <Authenticated> and <Unauthenticated> render nothing
on the server Convex doesn't know
who you are yet, so nothing inside
the providers is drawn. The landing
page is built entirely in the
Receives the almost-empty HTML + the JavaScript for the client components.
React "hydrates": attaches itself to the page and takes over.
new ConvexReactClient(NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL) → opens ONE WebSocket to Convex
a. Clerk loads your session in the browser
b. getToken({ template: "convex" }) → c. token sent to Convex over the WebSocket
d. Convex verifies it with convex/auth.config.ts (CLERK_JWT_ISSUER_DOMAIN)
page load: two queries per visit.
Both start as undefined → ProjectsList shows <Spinner /> (ui/spinner.tsx)
Both are sent over the same WebSocket as live subscriptions
document.addEventListener("keydown", …) → Ctrl J / Ctrl K now work
projects is now an array (0 projects → renders nothing)
"Recent projects" + "View all Ctrl K" (only if rest.length > 0)
Any change to your projects (e.g. New → create in convex/projects.ts) makes Convex
re-run the subscribed queries and push new results → step 10 runs again.
